lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: Up here, on the rooftops — this is where I do my best teaching. Burn steel. Tell me what you see.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: Lines. Dozens of them, running out into the dark.

lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: Those are every scrap of metal within range of you. Push on one, and you'll go somewhere. Let's see where.
